title: 900. Online Election

examples.explanation: The leader after each vote is [0,1,1,0,0,1,0]; each query picks the latest leader at or before its time.
Person 0 leads from the first vote onward.
Ties go to the most recently voted person: at time 10 the tie picks 2, at time 20 it picks 1.

hints: Precompute who leads right after every vote: track vote counts and let the newest vote win ties.
Each query asks for the latest vote time at or before it, which is a binary search over the sorted times.
Adaptation note: the original class interaction is flattened here into one batch call returning every query answer.
